title: Complete your booking
emptyDesc: Start by searching for a stay and picking a room to book.
invalidDatesDesc: A booking can span at most 30 nights, and check-out must be after check-in. Pick a new date range and try again.

guest.title: Guest details
guest.specialRequestsPlaceholder: Late check-in, high floor, extra bed…
guest.phoneFromProfile: The hotel will contact this number. Change your account number in Account.
guest.phoneWillSave: This number will be saved to your profile so the hotel can reach you.
guest.phoneTempNote: Used for this booking only — your account phone number stays unchanged.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.secureNote: You'll be securely redirected to VNPay to complete your payment.
payment.notCharged: You won't be charged until you complete payment at the gateway.
payment.sepayNote: You'll get a QR code to transfer to — we confirm your booking automatically.
payment.walletCovers: Your wallet covers this booking in full. Nothing is taken until you confirm on the last step.
payment.walletInsufficient: Your wallet has {{balance}}, which is short of the {{total}} total. StayHub does not support paying part of a booking from the wallet — please pick VNPay or the QR transfer.
payment.walletOnlyNote: This booking is paid entirely from your StayHub wallet — no payment gateway involved. Untick the box above to pay with VNPay or QR instead.
payment.walletSecureNote: The amount leaves your wallet the moment you confirm, and your booking is confirmed at the same time.
payment.walletNotCharged: Nothing is taken at this step — only when you confirm on the last one.
payment.walletPaidFull: Paid {{amount}} from your wallet. Your booking is confirmed.
payment.walletPaidPartial: {{amount}} taken from your wallet. {{remaining}} still to pay — pick a payment method to finish.
payment.unpaidTitle: This booking is not paid yet
payment.unpaidBody: Your room is only held until {{time}}. After that the booking is cancelled automatically and you'll have to book again.
payment.payError: Could not start the payment. Please try again.

trust.cancellationFallback: Cancellation terms are set by the property — see the property's policies.

confirm.title: Review & confirm
confirm.errorBooking: Could not create booking. The room may no longer be available for these dates.
confirm.errorPayment: Could not start the VNPay payment. Please try again.
confirm.priceUpdated: The property's final total is {{total}}, which differs from our estimate. Tap "Retry payment" to continue with this amount.

terms.required: Please agree to the terms to continue.
clauses: Your booking is confirmed only after successful payment through our gateway.
Prices include taxes and fees as set by the property, where applicable.
Check-in/out follows the property's hours and required identification.
Refund/cancellation terms follow the property's policy shown below.

vnpay.label: VNPAY
vnpay.desc: Pay via VNPAY QR / bank app

result.successBody: Your booking has been confirmed and a confirmation email is on its way. You can view your voucher in My Bookings.
result.failedBody: We could not complete your payment. Your room is held briefly — you can try paying again from My Bookings before the hold expires.

success.title: Booking confirmed!
success.body: A confirmation has been sent to your email. Show the QR below at check-in.

sepay.title: Bank transfer (SePay)
sepay.subtitle: Scan the QR or transfer manually
sepay.qrAlt: VietQR code for this bank transfer
sepay.keepContent: Keep the transfer content exactly as shown — it is how we match your payment automatically.
